v.title: Ipswich Women Set New Record with Ademiluyi Signing
v.excerpt: Ipswich Women break their transfer record to sign 17‑year‑old Princess Ademiluyi, signalling a new era of ambition in the Women’s Championship.
v.body:
## Quick take
Ipswich Town Women have just paid a club‑record fee to secure England youth international Princess Ademiluyi, a move that signals ambition in the Women's Championship.

## What happened
Ipswich Town Women confirmed the permanent signing of Princess Ademiluyi from Arsenal, paying a record fee for the club. The 17‑year‑old, who has already impressed at the youth international level, will join a squad that has been pushing for promotion in the Women’s Championship.
The announcement came after a successful loan spell at Ipswich, where Ademiluyi showcased her pace, technical skill and knack for scoring decisive goals. The club’s board highlighted the player’s potential to become a cornerstone of their attack and a future star for the national team.

## Why it matters
- **For Ipswich Women**: The record fee demonstrates a serious commitment to building a title‑challenging squad. By investing in a young, high‑ceiling talent like Ademiluyi, the club is signalling that it will compete for promotion and possibly a spot in the Women’s Super League.
- **For Ademiluyi**: The move offers her a stable platform to develop her game against stronger opposition. Regular first‑team football in a club that values youth will accelerate her readiness for senior international duty.
- **For the broader women’s game**: This transfer highlights the growing financial investment in women’s football. It encourages other clubs to raise their own budgets and could trigger a more competitive transfer market across the league.

## What's next
Watch how Ademiluyi adapts to the physicality of the Championship in the opening fixtures. Her performance in the first five games will be a key indicator of whether Ipswich can push for promotion. Keep an eye on her goal‑scoring form and link‑up play; a breakthrough season could see her on the radar of top‑flight clubs and the senior national squad.

*Source: [Ipswich Women sign Ademiluyi for record fee](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3x29q4nwe1ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)*
